card.name: Linking words before IV fluid names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, of, in, an) or a space just before an IV fluid name such as normal saline, sodium chloride or dextrose. Seen in dilution, infusion and fluid-replacement text.

modes.label: Linking word before saline
modes.description: With, an or of right before an intravenous infusion of normal saline.
modes.example: Volume expansion<< with>> an intravenous infusion of normal saline is

modes.label: Volume then fluid name
modes.description: The word of after an amount in mL or liters, before the diluent name.

modes.label: Inside fluid product names
modes.description: Partway through or just after a fluid product name, before the next fluid ingredient.

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before an IV fluid such as saline or dextrose is named.
